Messages.Author: Paul Steiner
Messages.Body:
The online rulebook says that you may not contest a card with yourself
but I am unsure as to how this is resolved. These scenerios are mostly
corner cases but are a result of my thinking baout the original case.
Scenerio 1- I have a Sengir dagger out and I take an action to equip a
second. Does the action never occur, fizzle (I'm tapped but no dagger),
or one of the daggers is burned immediately.
Scenerio 2- I have Stanislava out with the eye of Haziel and I
accidently influence out another Stanislava. (I love made up examples)
Are the transfers prevented, the last transfer is prevented, or
Stanislava just sits in my uncontrolled region with no blood or she
comes out and it is resolved as in Scenerio 1.
Scenerio 3- I have Anson out and call a vote to make Smudge the
Prince of Seattle in order to cycle cards. (Clearly Anson is going to
vote againist this vote even though it is my own) Is this a legal
action as it doesn't automatically contest the title in question.
Thanks,
Paul

Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
Paul Steiner wrote:
:: Scenerio 1- I have a Sengir dagger out

:: and I take an action to equip a second. Does the action never
:: occur, fizzle (I'm tapped but no dagger), or one of the daggers is
:: burned immediately.

The second dagger burns as it enter play.
Alternat answer : you play with cool guys who will just point you are going
to equip for nothing, and you "take back the card & do sumthin'else" =)

:: Scenerio 2- I have Stanislava out with the

:: eye of Haziel and I accidently influence out another Stanislava.
:: (I love made up examples)

The other Stanislava enters play, burning immediatly.
note: it works this way even when you don't control the Eye of Hazimel ;)

:: Scenerio 3- I have Anson out and call a vote to

:: make Smudge the Prince of Seattle in order to cycle cards.
:: (Clearly Anson is going to vote againist this vote even though it
:: is my own) Is this a legal action as it doesn't automatically
:: contest the title in question.

It's an illegal action since Anson cannot name another vampire a Prince
using a Praxis Seizure card.
However, Smudge can play a praxis Seizure to become the Prince of Seattle =)
(Or Anson can call the praxis Seizure for himself ;) )
The title doesn't automatically contest, but your friends on the table will
certainly vote in favor only to see you embarrased as Smudge becomes the new
prince =)

reyda

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Paul Steiner wrote:
>
> The online rulebook says that you may not contest a card with yourself
> but I am unsure as to how this is resolved. These scenerios are mostly
> corner cases but are a result of my thinking baout the original case.
> Scenerio 1- I have a Sengir dagger out and I take an action to equip a
> second. Does the action never occur, fizzle (I'm tapped but no dagger),
> or one of the daggers is burned immediately.

The action cannot be attempted. The card is not played. The minion doesn't tap.

> Scenerio 2- I have Stanislava out with the eye of Haziel and I
> accidently influence out another Stanislava. (I love made up examples)
> Are the transfers prevented, the last transfer is prevented, or
> Stanislava just sits in my uncontrolled region with no blood or she
> comes out and it is resolved as in Scenerio 1.

Stanislava "comes out" to the ash heap.

> Scenerio 3- I have Anson out and call a vote to make Smudge the
> Prince of Seattle in order to cycle cards. (Clearly Anson is going to
> vote againist this vote even though it is my own) Is this a legal
> action as it doesn't automatically contest the title in question.

Titles are not cards - they can be contested.

No, you don't read correctly ;)
smudge has to be a tzimisce in order to attempt to equip with the femur.
However, if smudge has a vast wealth (a fact that most of us just ignored)
and taps to equip with the first equipment from your library, he may end up
equipping with a Femur. If it is the casen then the femur is burned without
paying the cost.

Voila !

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

No. Smudge cannot attempt to equip the Femur because he doesn't
meet the requirements.

The above is talking about Vast Wealth. If Smudge attempts the Vast
Wealth action and the equipment retrieved is the Femur, then the Femur
is burned without cost.

> Yes. The order/contents of your library is not treated as a "known", even
> if you do happen to know it.

You can actually base a strategy around this fact if you really wanted to..
Tusk the Talebearer lets you look at the top card in your library.
Put a bunch of "search for equipment and reshuffle" effects (Vast Wealth,
Thomas Steed, Magic of the Smith, ...) in the deck and no equipment to back
it up.. so you can reshuffle til you get the top card you wanted.
Or you can keep reshuffling near endgame if you're going for that precious
half-point.
You'll probably get beaten up for doing so, though... :)
